links.outcome: IDH rate, CPR, falls, and mortality before vs after BestShape implementation
links.effect: Monthly IDH rate fell from 27% in 2019 to 21% in 2023 (P<.001); CPR 8 to 3 per month; falls 21 to 7; mortality 8% vs 9.3% (P=.260). Historical-control design, not randomized.
links.quote: The mean monthly IDH rate significantly reduced from 27% in 2019 to 21% in 2023 (P < .001).

links.outcome: Clinical, financial, and satisfaction KPIs tracked after AI deployment
links.effect: Reductions in IDH, CPR, and falls; estimated annual cost savings USD 115,658; mean personnel satisfaction score 86.
links.quote: The estimated annual cost savings by implementing BestShape were USD 115 658.

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical and economic outcomes before and after real-world deployment of the BestShape AI system for real-time intradialytic hypotension prediction in hemodialysis units.
